notes: καθάπερ has no answering καί, so it keeps even as whole, headed on as (rule 82's final arm).
οὐ and πάντα stay separate: the ASV writes two English words (all … not), which is rule 87's closing case rather than the single-no join.
τὴν αὐτήν gives the to the article and same to the intensive pronoun, as rule 60's αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ → that very hour does; rule 107 is not in point, no -self word being written.
